∀ (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (u : WaveMap.Space n × ℝ → WaveMap.Space m) (q : WaveMap.Space m) (h_H001 : 1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m) (h_H002 : ContDiffOn ℝ (∞ : ℕ∞ω) u (WaveMap.positive n)) (h_H003 : ‖q‖ = 1) (h_H004 : ∀ (x : WaveMap.Space n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ‖u (x,t)‖ = 1) (h_H005 : ∀ (x : WaveMap.Space n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∃ a : ℝ, WaveMap.utt u x t - WaveMap.laplace u x t = a • u (x,t)) (h_H006 : ∀ (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → ∃ C : Set (WaveMap.Space n), IsCompact C ∧ ∀ x : WaveMap.Space n, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, u (x,r) = q), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => WaveMap.density u x t)) ∧
  (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (WaveMap.energy u) 0 t) ∧
  (∀ (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < t → WaveMap.energy u s = WaveMap.energy u t)

correspondence.explanation: The parameters n,m are natural dimensions with H001 enforcing n,m≥1. Space d is standard real Euclidean d-space, with Fin d enumerating precisely the d original coordinates. H002 is joint C∞ regularity on the positive-time open set: ∞ in ℕ∞ω denotes all finite derivative orders and does not demand analyticity. The ambient total u represents the source positive-time map by restriction; conversely extend any source map arbitrarily (e.g. zero) on nonpositive times. All hypotheses and positive-time derivatives depend only on the restriction, so neither direction imposes an extension or boundary regularity assumption. H003 fixes a unit q; H004 is the original sphere condition. H005 is pointwise existence of a real scalar for the same normal acceleration, with no smooth scalar selection. H006 is the same compact support of u−q, locally uniform on each 0<s<t interval. Under smoothness, Fréchet derivatives on coordinate unit vectors and ordinary time derivatives give precisely the source component derivatives and Laplacian. volume is normalized Euclidean Lebesgue measure, and density is exactly ‖ut‖²+Σj‖uxj‖². The conclusion asserts integrability for every positive time, HasDerivAt energy 0 at every positive time, and equality of the energies at all positive time pairs. HasDerivAt is equivalent to differentiability together with derivative zero; the converse uses uniqueness of derivatives. Germ locality at t>0 makes this equivalent to the source energy on (0,∞), independent of the exterior representative. Thus the entire target, including all six hypotheses, time and spatial quantifiers, normalization and domain, is preserved in both directions. There are no E roots in the supplied source map.
